subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these exact third-party action revisions in workflows that handle secrets, publishing, security scans, repository mutation, and Codex agents?
rationale: Syntax checks and ordinary CI cannot establish trust in changed executable dependencies, and repository policy requires explicit owner judgment for this protected security boundary.

options.title: Audit and approve exact pins
options.body: Review upstream source changes and the rebased exact-head runs, then merge if permissions, inputs, and behavior remain acceptable.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land low-privilege setup actions separately and review token, publishing, security, mutation, and Codex actions in focused PRs.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Close or supersede the grouped bump if the supply-chain review cost outweighs the maintenance benefit.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve exact pins
recommendation.body: Review upstream source changes and the rebased exact-head runs, then merge if permissions, inputs, and behavior remain acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-workflow ownership and direct engagement with this PR make steipete the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
